name: For Ambergris
source:
After work one day Jamie receives a request for photography services from a mysterious character. The proposition is rather odd seeing as Jamie is a warehouse operative working a zero-hour contract and by no means a professional photographer.

[From [url=http://sleepyagents.itch.io/for-ambergris]itch.io[/url]]

Created for SuNoFes 2015.
translation:
某天工作结束后，杰米收到一名神秘人物的摄影委托。这个提议相当奇怪，因为杰米是按零时合同工作的仓库员工，完全不是专业摄影师。

本作为SuNoFes 2015创作。

[来源：[url=http://sleepyagents.itch.io/for-ambergris]itch.io[/url]]
